detail.title: MOT-1 typed composition ledger and first-failure localization
detail.description:
Picked up from Library handoff: PNP_TO_HODGE_TYPED_FAILURE_CARRIER.md

METHOD TRANSFER ONLY — NO PNP EVIDENCE TRANSFER.

Immediate gate:
Build a machine-readable typed ledger for every current MOT-1 correspondence edge.

Required edge fields:

* source motive
* target motive
* projector
* codimension
* direction
* transpose/inverse
* scalar normalization
* Tate twist
* Kummer factor
* Artin factor
* base field
* realization action
* verification status

Execution discipline:

1. compose left-to-right;
2. stop at the first failed interface;
3. do not skip downstream;
4. preserve a failure carrier containing original source, intended/actual target, projector/twist/normalization/base-field state, before/after realizations, failed edge, reason, rollback point, and remainder;
5. repair only that interface;
6. rerun normalization and terminal realization checks.

Terminal local acceptance:
R(Gamma_MOT1)(v_source) = c \* v_target with c != 0,
or the exactly oriented equivalent, while retaining all Chow-level, field-of-definition, projector, twist, and inverse obligations.

Pair-ablation is allowed strictly as a debugging diagnostic, not as proof of causal geometry.

This issue is a proof-construction compiler/debugging layer. It does not itself establish a Hodge result.

### First-failure localization — 2026-10-05

Compiler verdict from pinned audited W114 packets:

PASS through:

* degree-114 duplication divisor primitives;
* q4 plane pullback;
* full level-114 common-carrier join/permutation composition;
* q8 power-map reduction;
* level-57 standard join composition;
* full W114 -> T_A standard reduction;
* 19-standard Aoki carrier;
* Chow tensor-square correspondence;
* normalized M^2 \~= A_114(19,76).

FIRST FAILED / UNCONSTRUCTED EDGE:

N = M tensor A_114(19,76)
  --> A_114(3(7-zeta_3),57)

Equivalent reverse-form obligation:
construct Gamma subset E6 x F_57^16 of cycle dimension 8 such that
F=e_TA\[Gamma\]e_chi != 0,
with E6=Spec K\[r,t\]/(r^3+19,t^2-3(7-zeta_3)),
chi(sigma)=zeta_3, chi(tau)=-1,
and inverse
G=(1/(6c)) e_chi\[Gamma\]^t e_TA
for nonzero dual pairing c.

This is classified as MISSING_GEOMETRIC_EDGE, not an arithmetic type mismatch.

### Exact candidate oracle

T_A =
(1,4,7,16,25,28,43,49,55,54,45,36,9,39,30,42,24,6).

Dual-pullback Jacobian exponents:
(55,52,49,40,31,28,13,7,1,2,11,20,47,17,26,14,32,50).

For Q57=sum\_{i=1}^9 f_i*g_i, compute*
*D=det Jac(f1,g1,...,f9,g9) mod (x0^56,...,x17^56).*
*At the exact target monomial, the coefficient lies in basis*
*{1,r,r^2,t,r*t,r^2*t}.*
*The required source character selects the r*t component (subject to the fixed orientation convention).
Zero r\*t => immediate rejection.

### New scoped no-go

Within the standard Fermat monomial automorphisms stabilizing the fixed T_A eigenspace:

* all 18 T_A residues are distinct, so any coordinate permutation stabilizer is identity;
* diagonal character values have odd order dividing 57, so none equals -1.

Therefore the tau=-1 quadratic sign cannot be supplied solely by an ambient monomial symmetry orbit of one fixed cycle.

Consequence:
the quadratic sign must live in the cycle-family/descent geometry itself, or in a more general correspondence.

Boundary:
MONOMIAL_AUTOMORPHISM_NO_GO != NO_EXCEPTIONAL_CYCLE.
